name: v2.5.26-dev.2-alpha28
body:
## What's new in v2.5.26-dev.2-alpha28

- fix(kiosk): restore radio station logos in menu-tile lists
- feat(kiosk): make the inserted CD a first-class album everywhere
- feat(website): refine the Quick start guide tutorial
- feat(website): add a Quick start guide popup to the hero
- companion: release 1.0.18 (versionCode 41)
- website: make the 'general enquiries' contact line a visible callout
- website: let the support form take several files (5 MB total)
- website: send the support-form notice via Resend
- website: replace the support mailto box with a report form
- website: point companion download to 1.0.17
- companion: promote 1.0.17 to stable (bespoke album page, Qt-aligned settings)
- site: point companion download to 1.0.15
- companion: promote 1.0.15 to stable (kiosk UI, dual-proxy)
- Fix version extraction from GitHub tag
- website: count Ko-fi "Tip" donations in the supporters strip
- website: a beta version to download, ISO and USB image
